turns.query: Compute the Voronoi (Thiessen) tessellation of all 18 air-quality monitoring stations and clip each cell to the axis-aligned bounding box of all station coordinates. Use geodesic area (cast to geography) in km². Return the area (km², 1 dp) of the Voronoi cell belonging to the Sha Tin station (station_id 11).
code_snippets:
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sqlalchemy import text

# Step 1: Get all station coordinates
query = text("""
SELECT id, name_en, ST_X(coordinate::geometry) as lon, ST_Y(coordinate::geometry) as lat
FROM air_quality_station
ORDER BY id
""")
stations = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print("Station count:", len(stations))
print(stations)

# Step 2: Compute bounding box of all stations
min_lon = stations['lon'].min()
max_lon = stations['lon'].max()
min_lat = stations['lat'].min()
max_lat = stations['lat'].max()
print(f"Bounding box: lon [{min_lon:.6f}, {max_lon:.6f}], lat [{min_lat:.6f}, {max_lat:.6f}]")

# Step 3: Create Voronoi tessellation using PostGIS
# Use ST_VoronoiPolygons on the MultiPoint of all stations, then clip to bounding box
query_voronoi = text("""
WITH station_points AS (
    SELECT id, coordinate::geometry AS geom
    FROM air_quality_station
),
voronoi_raw AS (
    SELECT (ST_Dump(ST_VoronoiPolygons(
        ST_Collect(geom),
        0.0,  -- tolerance
        ST_MakeEnvelope(:min_lon, :min_lat, :max_lon, :max_lat, 4326)
    ))).geom AS cell_geom
    FROM station_points
),
voronoi_cells AS (
    SELECT 
        sp.id,
        sp.geom AS station_geom,
        vr.cell_geom,
        ST_Area(ST_Intersection(vr.cell_geom, ST_MakeEnvelope(:min_lon, :min_lat, :max_lon, :max_lat, 4326))::geography) / 1000000.0 AS area_km2
    FROM station_points sp
    JOIN voronoi_raw vr ON ST_Contains(vr.cell_geom, sp.geom)
)
SELECT id, area_km2 FROM voronoi_cells
ORDER BY id
""")

result = pd.read_sql(query_voronoi, engine, params={
    'min_lon': min_lon, 'min_lat': min_lat,
    'max_lon': max_lon, 'max_lat': max_lat
})
print("\nVoronoi cell areas (km²):")
print(result)

# Step 4: Extract Sha Tin (station_id 11)
shatin_row = result[result['id'] == 11]
if len(shatin_row) > 0:
    shatin_cell_km2 = round(float(shatin_row['area_km2'].values[0]), 1)
    print(f"\nSha Tin Voronoi cell area: {shatin_cell_km2} km²")
else:
    print("Sha Tin station not found in Voronoi results")
    shatin_cell_km2 = None

# Store the result in the required variable
shatin_cell_km2 = round(float(result[result['id'] == 11]['area_km2'].values[0]), 1)
print(f"shatin_cell_km2 = {shatin_cell_km2}")
